column1: # Metro rules: towns shown as their city (final architecture: Q5 = the metro, the whole city).
# rule adm2:<bundle district>: every town inside that regions-bundle district (ADM2, vertex for vertex) is shown as
# `metro`; check_name must equal the district's bundle name, so a renumbered bundle fails the build instead of folding
# the wrong district. rule place:<geonameid>: one town is shown as `metro`. Sections of a city (GeoNames PPLX) need no
# row: each takes the nearest larger non-section town within 15 km of the same country.
# Tokyo: the 23 special wards (the app's WardCity table); the Tama cities (Hachioji, Machida, Fuchu, Chofu...) stay
# rule admin1:<GeoNames country>.<admin1 code> with km: every town of that first-order division within km of
# the metro is shown as the metro (a city-province's districts: Istanbul, Mexico City); separate towns farther out
# keep their names. check_name: the metro's English name (adm2 rules: the district's bundle name).
